introduction.summary: The study measured the taxonomic and functional trait structure of ground beetle assemblages in restored tallgrass prairies, and also measured seed and arthropod predation to relate management, beetle assemblage characteristics, and function.

methods.summary: This study measured the presence and activity of American bison within various restored and remnant tallgrass prairie sites at Nachusa Grasslands. The study measured various traits of ground-dwelling arthropods, specifically ground beetles, collected from different land management treatments across multiple sites. The study measured seed predation on four prairie plant species and arthropod predation on wax worm larvae across different sites and time points.
